title: heleniastrum autumnale
intro: Heleniastrum autumnale, commonly known as Autumn Gentian, is a flowering plant native to the Himalayas and parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce stress and improve cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Heleniastrum autumnale include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-bacterial and anti-viral activities. The bioactive constituents present in Heleniastrum autumnale include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
